recipe.title: Crockpot Sweet Potato Lentils
recipe.description: These Crockpot Sweet Potato Lentils include coconut milk and are filling and healthy! Perfect over warm naan for lunch or dinner.
ingredients: 2 teaspoon each ground coriander, garam masala, and chili powder
instructions: Place the sweet potatoes, vegetable broth, onion, garlic, and spices in a crockpot. Cook on high for 3 hours, until vegetables are soft.
Add the lentils and stir once. Replace the lid and cook on high for an additional 1 1/2 hours.
Stir in the coconut milk and as much water as needed to get the right consistency.
